name: Flexor Hallucis Longus Tenosynovitis
definition: Inflammation or stenosing tenosynovitis of the flexor hallucis longus tendon, common in dancers and athletes with repeated plantar flexion.

investigations.principle: Dynamic ultrasound or MRI can confirm tenosynovitis/tendon pathology.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, cartilage, tendon, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Persistent stenosing symptoms may require injection or surgical release.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

patientEducation.summary: Inflammation or stenosing tenosynovitis of the flexor hallucis longus tendon, common in dancers and athletes with repeated plantar flexion.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, severe deformity, progressive weakness, suspected tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
